Maps (Switch 2)

Nintendo Switch 2
Maps of the areas and dungeons in the Switch 2 version.

Simplified maps redrawn by this site based on the in-game map screens. Red circles are Pieces of Heart, yellow circles are Gold Skulltulas, chest icons are chests and blue diamonds are events; the numbers in the circles match the Pieces of Heart and Gold Skulltulas lists. Tap a circle to jump to how to get it (hover over a chest or diamond to see its name). Positions were checked against the in-game map and in play, but the map shapes are simplified, so exact positions may be slightly off.
